ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic map of the Xinjiang region; in the middle inside the outline there is an obvious nearly east-west mountain belt, dividing Xinjiang into two major regions, north and south. Mountain lines are also drawn around the periphery, and the main bodies on the north and south sides show basin forms. Then reason: The central mountain range can correspond to the Tianshan Mountains; south of the Tianshan Mountains is the Tarim Basin of Southern Xinjiang, and north of them is the Junggar Basin of Northern Xinjiang. Xinjiang lies deep in the interior, far from the ocean, and is blocked by surrounding mountains, so water vapor is difficult to reach and precipitation is low. Therefore, Southern Xinjiang and Northern Xinjiang mostly belong to arid regions.
